Careers

Let’s shape the Future of Manufacturing with AI - together!

Our mission is to empower manufacturers with our cutting-edge artificial intelligence platform that revolutionizes production, enhances efficiency, and drives innovation.

If you’re passionate about the convergence of technology and industry and want to make a real impact, you’ve come to the right place.
At DataDudes, you’ll work with a dynamic group of professionals who are experts in their respective fields but dedicated to fostering a culture of collaboration.


We encourage a hybrid model, including collaborative work in our offices in Beer-Sheva’s hi-tech park with team members from Beer Sheva, Tel Aviv, Nof-Haglil, and digital nomads traveling overseas.
